doc.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025

title: Where melodies come from
summary: Levy says music exists in its own place and musicians grab ideas from it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Where did the initial – sometimes you can’t answer these kind of questions but the melodies, where do they come from?

That’s a really good question. I have no idea, man. Music – I think music exists in its own place and we grab things out of it. I really believe that. Because we don’t invent them. Some of it is just imitation, a lot of it actually. Because like I said, you know I listen, I’m listening constantly. I’m just all the time listening and turning other people on to like, “Listen to this.” I’m like one of those guys. “Did you ever hear this?” You know, that kind of stuff. But I don’t know, I think they reside in a place and we just grab them.
